verdict.summary: Round 3 remains sound as scoped. The holder-count and per-holder commitment-count words make the commitment-digest preimage structurally unambiguous, and the focused regression test is non-vacuous because it first demonstrates equality of the formerly flattened preimages before checking that the corrected digest and freshness tag differ. The public-input layout separately binds holder and row arities, freshness validation fails closed, and all prose consistently describes this as layout/out-of-circuit binding only: no proof or ZK-audit item is claimed complete, external audit sq-qhy4 remains pending, and the MPC trust model remains honest-majority semi-honest. This matches the M4-v1 feasibility record. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or instruction-injection issue was found. With round 2 also clean, progress is stagnant rather than improving or regressing.
